description.en: Removes a number of an item from the player's items. The item is given by its ID string or hash.
Item ID, e.g. "iii0002", or its hash.

The removal's result (true once removed; true too when the item data is not available).
null if the script system is not ready or fewer than 2 arguments are given.

examples.case: Handing over an item (real usage, from ev42040800.nut)
